correctness.rationale: The exact domain, cross-ratio normalization, Euclidean volume and all quantifiers are specified. Projective softmax coordinates yield strictly log-concave analytic density; Prékopa and permutation symmetry prove global centroid volume optimality, and analyticity with decay proves uniqueness for every t>0. A positive-measure strict transposition witness proves unique geometric median. The unit-exponential minimum gives the beta-product CDF and central mean; iid logistic ratios give the pair CDF and harmonic mean; standard extreme-value arguments give two distinct Gumbel limits. The included standalone Python verifier passes 167 diagnostic comparisons; finite numerics do not replace the universal proof.

value.rationale: The exact all-dimensional relative Euclidean volume of Hilbert balls and unique maximizing centers answer a natural baseline calibration problem on probability simplices, while the simultaneous unique expected-distance center and uniform-pair distance law specify geometric typicality. Distinct one-Gumbel versus two-Gumbel scales reveal nontrivial high-dimensional behavior. Complete exact natural model plus rigid optimizer is more than a textbook coordinate identity or an arbitrary finite parameter.
